description: This file defines the 'Waiter' class used for managing event waiting, timeouts, and error handling within the Playwright core library, including utility functions for event handling and logging.

classes.name: Waiter
classes.description: A class for managing event waiting, logging, and error handling with support for timeouts and immediate errors.

methods.name: createForEvent
methods.description: Static method to create a Waiter instance for a specific event.

methods.name: waitForEvent
methods.description: Waits for a specific event on an EventEmitter with optional predicate filtering.

methods.name: rejectOnEvent
methods.description: Rejects the wait if a specified event occurs with an error.

methods.name: rejectOnTimeout
methods.description: Rejects the wait if a timeout occurs.

methods.name: rejectImmediately
methods.description: Immediately rejects the wait with a specified error.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up event listeners and resources.

methods.name: waitForPromise
methods.description: Waits for a promise to resolve or reject, handling immediate errors and logging.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a message and sends it via the channel.

methods.name: _rejectOn
methods.description: Internal method to add a rejection promise to the failure list.
